name: faq-interactive-preview
title: Interactive FAQ Preview
description: A dark split FAQ: six questions sit as a plain list while a large rounded panel beside them shows the chosen question, its answer and an abstract swirl picture. Hovering or clicking a row changes the panel.
use: A product page wants FAQs where each question swaps a large visual answer instead of expanding inline.
avoid: Only one answer shows at a time, and the tall fixed panel leaves dead space under short answers.
a11y: Questions are real buttons that work from the keyboard, but the preview swap is not announced and motion ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Very dark page with a small centred heading. The left column is six question rows, one filled in a slightly lighter rounded card with a right arrow; the right is a large rounded panel holding a tiny MAGIC PREVIEW label, a bold question, a grey paragraph and a wide abstract image.
behaves: Hovering or clicking a question highlights its row and slides a fresh panel in from the right, swapping the title, answer and swirl image. An arrow slides into the active row while the others stay plain.
customise: The six questions, answers and image URLs are in a hardcoded array; the active-row styling and panel height need source edits.
weight: light: Six rows and one animated panel; nothing loops or runs while idle.
